_comment.version: Schema version (2 = structured notebook permissions map; 1 = legacy flat array).
_comment.provider_mode: Execution mode for the browser companion. 'browser' = Manifest V3 extension (default).
_comment.accounts: List of Google account email addresses permitted to access notebooks via MCP. Empty = all authenticated accounts.
_comment.notebooks: Map of notebook IDs to {'title': str, 'mode': 'READ_ONLY' | 'INTERACTIVE'}. Empty = no notebooks allowed (deny-all default).
